title: Optimize skill descriptions for triggering
description: Run the skill-creator description optimizer per skill with should and should-not trigger queries.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each skill has a 20-query trigger set and a recorded held-out score

implementationNotes: Started 2026-10-20 under ODOC-497 (operator-approved, opum-doc#1133). Plan: per skill, a 20-query trigger set (10 true triggers, 10 near-misses drawn from the sibling perf skills and proof/test territory), run from a neutral cwd so the symlinked real skills cannot compete, with --model pinned; baseline and final held-out scores and the run metadata under evals/results/. A candidate description that does not beat the baseline on held-out is not adopted and the result is recorded.

Result 2026-10-20: three 20-query sets (evals/trigger/), held-out baselines perf-ci 5/8, perf-measure 4/8, perf-optimize 4/8 (8 held-out queries, 2 runs each, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude 2.1.299, skill-creator 315c4e48967d). The loop's best candidates were perf-ci none (baseline), perf-measure 7/8 and perf-optimize 5/8 at iteration 2; each swung back to 4/8 at iteration 3 and is selected on the held-out set, so none was adopted and no description changed. Recall, not precision, is the weak side. Details and the re-score recommendation in evals/trigger/results/README.md.

STAGE 1 VERDICT for opum-ai/profile-skills#9 at bb712973121c29826059d134e8260ee4faaac5e5, as relayed by team-lead (the verdict file itself was not provided to this session; this is the relay text, recorded as received): opum-doc's Opus verdict is APPROVE once two docs fixes land at the moved head, with no re-review (opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5, by ref, about 22:50Z). Sound: the train and held-out sets are disjoint and stratified 6/6 and 4/4, with the split identical across the 3 iterations; every per-query pass recomputes from trigger_rate at 0.5; every score cited exists in a results file; original_description == the committed SKILL.md byte for byte, and no SKILL.md changed; the candidates share 5-grams only with train queries; the held-out selection is disclosed, and nothing was adopted; AC met. FIX BEFORE LANDING: (1) README.md:165 still says trigger descriptions are not yet optimized (PSKI-9): reword to point at evals/trigger/results/README.md with the outcome, and add evals/trigger/ to the layout line at :147. (2) docs/stories/skill-evaluation-suite.md:25 promises iteration results recorded below but records none for PSKI-9: add a short trigger-eval section linking the results README. NITs: say best_description and final_description are candidates NOT adopted; name the basis of recall 17-25%; note on PSKI-9 that the results moved to evals/trigger/results/. FOLLOW-UP, not blocking: CI does not read evals/trigger/**. Both fixes and all three NITs are applied in the follow-up commit.
finalSummary: PSKI-9 done under ODOC-497. Added a 20-query trigger set per skill (evals/trigger/) and recorded held-out scores with run metadata in evals/trigger/results/. Baselines on 8 held-out queries: perf-ci 5/8, perf-measure 4/8, perf-optimize 4/8. No candidate description was adopted: the best candidates (perf-measure 7/8, perf-optimize 5/8) were selected on the 8-query held-out set and fell back to 4/8 on the next iteration, so the gain is within noise. Recall is the weak side (perf-ci loop: precision 100%, recall 17-25%).
